errors.auth: The server didn't accept the username or password. Some providers need an app password.
errors.plainPort: This server doesn't encrypt connections on this port: it needs STARTTLS, or TLS on its encrypted port (usually 993 for incoming mail, 465 for outgoing).
errors.noStartTls: This server doesn't offer STARTTLS on this port: it needs TLS, usually on port 993 for incoming mail and 465 for outgoing.
errors.certificate: The server's certificate isn't trusted, so the app didn't connect. It may have expired or be self-signed.
errors.tls: Couldn't set up a secure connection to the server.
errors.relay: The web relay couldn't open a connection to the server. Check the server name and port, and the relay in Settings.
errors.unreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection, and the server name and port.
errors.server: The server returned an error. Try again in a moment.
errors.device: Couldn't read or save data on this device.
